title: Template:MountSkillRow
text: Row template for Template:Mount. One call per mount skill, filled in by External Data (#display_external_table). It reads the cooldown, casting time, mana cost and the highlighted description of the skill from aa-classic.com and hands everything to Module:Mount as one line of text. Not meant to be used on its own.

wikitext:
<includeonly>{{#get_web_data:
url=https://aa-classic.com/data/skills/{{{sid}}}.json
|format=json with jsonpath
|data=cd=$.cooldown_text,cast=$.casting_text,mana=$.mana_cost,cdesc=$.description,cicon=$.icon
|suppress error
}}{{{slevel}}}¦{{{sname}}}¦{{{sdesc}}}¦{{#external_value:cd}}¦{{#external_value:cast}}¦{{#external_value:mana}}¦{{#external_value:cdesc}}¦{{#external_value:cicon}}‖</includeonly><noinclude>
Row template for Template:Mount. One call per mount skill, filled in by External Data (#display_external_table).
It reads the cooldown, casting time, mana cost and the highlighted description of the skill from aa-classic.com and hands everything to Module:Mount as one line of text.
Not meant to be used on its own.
</noinclude>
